regions.explanation: From 59.15s to 66.44s (“gathering clouds and raging storms. At these moments, …”), the share of energy above 2 kHz dropped to 3.1% from 16.9% (-81%); that is 2.5× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Energy above 2 kHz carries consonant bursts and fricatives (t, k, s, f); losing it blurs word boundaries and makes the speech sound muffled even at normal volume. Fix: Open the mouth more and finish final consonants crisply.
